AC-05.note: at creation: a supplied clock tint resolves through the governed colour table. Per frame: the caller's time, read through the pointer; each field the format draws must fit its slots (ValueTooLarge) and lie in the range CivilTime documents, and a drawn date must exist (FieldOutOfRange), or the frame is refused; a null time leaves every Clock deferred. Everything create() checked is checked again on every frame, because the binding views slots the caller still owns: a slot renamed after creation refuses the frame, as SlotRetargeted when the new name is another valid target on the screen

AC-10.note: unit tests of each refusal and a noheap case exist; no pixel test compares a drawn time; the pinned corpus carries BINDING and PRESENTATION vectors naming this component, and MduX claims and runs only the compiler phases and the RENDERED and EVIDENCE profiles. Those BINDING vectors also refuse an impossible date and a five-digit year under TimeSeconds, where recordClock() checks only the fields the format draws - a divergence to settle before that profile is claimed

AC-05.note: at creation: the slot names a stream a SignalTrace on this screen carries, and has a ring and a usable style. Per frame: the ring's count is refused as TooManySamples past maxSamplesPerTrace, a non-finite sample as NonFiniteSample and a degenerate range as MalformedStyle. A finite sample outside the display range is drawn at its rail, under AC-05's display-saturation convention. Everything create() checked is checked again on every frame, because the binding views slots the caller still owns: a slot renamed after creation refuses the frame, as SlotRetargeted when the new name is another valid target on the screen
